profile.headline: Software Engineer at Apple
profile.summary: I am an experienced software engineer with a passion for learning about and adapting to our ever-evolving industry and using my skills to create programs that increase organizational efficiency and efficacy. Most recently, I have worked to develop a web portal for Dinan Engineering, managing the project from the initial stages of gathering information about user needs through the program development and front end user documentation stages. I not only evaluated the needs of diverse departments (from sales to accounting), but also have an ongoing relationship with each department to troubleshoot any problems or provide training to new employees. My skills go far beyond this most recent project; I have also pursued projects in systems engineering, quality assurance, data encryption, and much more. I enjoy diverse pursuits in my field that constantly challenge my abilities. If you are interested in learning more about my work or are also passionate about software engineering, please feel free to contact me today.

positions.title: Web Developer - Backend
positions.description:
Responsible for ongoing development, and maintenance of communication portals, allowing the finance department to improve workflow in financial processes. Maintained and enhanced existing Web applications and integrated systems using CodeIgniter, PHP and Javascript and MySQL. Delivered a wide range of functional, user interface and performance improvements to several existing web-based applications.
KEY ACCOMPLISHMENTS:
•	Developed functional and user-interface enhancement to a database-driven communication portal and collaborative workspace Web application, and completed project weeks ahead of schedule.
•	Worked with business to debug and troubleshoot trouble tickets in different environments to reproduce and eliminate user-interface and stability bugs.
•	Complied with team and Apple development standards, partnering with the necessary security teams to properly secure code.
•	Coordinate with System Administrator on hardware plan and needs.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for design, ongoing development, and maintenance of a crucial company-wide portal, allowing employees from all departments to access and manipulate customer data, part numbers, prices, sales metrics, and accounting information. Assist Technical Support Department in assessing and solving customer issues by evaluating log files and calibration files for related errors. Progressively assume managerial responsibilities such as drafting proposals for purchase of necessary project materials, creating user manuals for new programs, and regularly training various staff members to utilize web portal to maximize productivity. 
KEY ACCOMPLISHMENTS: 
• Collect information about each department’s functionality needs in order to design new web portal with tailored user controls for each area of the organization, ultimately increasing overall efficiency across the organization, especially in sales, accounting, and tech support where they gained functionalities that were not previously available, some tasks became automated, and data accessibility increased. 
• Collaborate with diverse departments on a regular basis to translate technical information, troubleshoot web portal issues, and train new users to utilize the portal effectively. 
• Updated billing software to make important calculations at billing time, including any sales and price changes according to their effective dates, and to utilize a script integrated into the iMipp service. 
• Implemented a dealer portal that accesses customer data, retrieves FAQs, and download ECU Programming Distribution Software information, thus increasing dealer efficacy in sales and customer service. 
• Created custom reports outlining monthly sales numbers, allowing the CEO, Sales Management, and Accounting to evaluate price reductions on underperforming software and to identify best selling models in order to increase profits.
• Taught new employee board programming and continued to mentor them as needed.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Responsible for managing a variety of projects from software maintenance and development to customer support. Wrote documentation to support customers through installation and use of software products. 
KEY ACCOMPLISHMENTS: 
• Identified errors in log files and calibration files to help Technical Support resolve client issues. 
• Maintained and improved functionality of the last generation ECU Programming Distribution Software by adding and modifying existing MFC Dialog Boxes for additional stages and/or new available parts, and thoroughly testing each modification through workstation and the HP Palmtop (end system). 
• Built and release engineered software by maintaining source code repository and testing/releasing the software package for delivery to 129 dealers throughout the United States on a monthly basis.

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description:
Description: 
Consulted with clients on location to service and repair production servers and printers ranging from AIX Servers/Dot Matrix Printers to Dell Blade Servers/HP LaserJet Printers. 
KEY ACCOMPLISHMENTS:
• Tested new server components in a running environment to ensure proper functionality before installing on a customer production server, thus increasing each Service Engineer’s efficiency. 
• Communicated with clients at each site to thoroughly assess each case and provide accurate and efficient support.

positions.title: Quality Assurance Intern
positions.description:
QUALITY ASSURANCE INTERN 
Responsible for testing hard drives by loading them onto the test area and running tests developed by engineers. 
KEY ACCOMPLISHMENTS: 
• Awarded internship through MESA after undergoing competitive application process. 
• Trusted to learn scripting to run original durability tests on hard drives, after demonstrating ability to take on more challenging roles.

projects.title: Smart Home
projects.description: Using a central hub, you can control Window locks, Door locks or any Sensors (such as fire sensors) through a computer application. C#.NET, SQL, XML

projects.title: SIC/XE Linker/Loader
projects.description: Given machine code from an SIC/XE assembler, link other objects into the machine code and load onto memory ready for execution. C/C++
